items.name: Qobuz Club: Jazz For A Rainy Day
items.description:
Discover a selection of jazz for a rainy day curated by Qobuz Club!
Qobuz Club is the exclusive online club for audiophiles and music lovers.

items.name: 50 Jazz Tracks to Test your Speakers
items.description:
Get the most out of your audio system with this 100% Hi-Res selection of 50 instrumental and vocal Jazz tracks that will test the limits of your equipment's capabilities and bring out its full potential.

Featuring Art Blakey & The Jazz Messengers, John Coltrane, Stan Getz, Miles Davis, Charles Mingus, Sonny Rollins, Lee Morgan, Ben Webster, Herbie Hancock, Manu Katché, Avishai Cohen, Lee Ritenour, Michel Petrucciani, High Pulp, DOMi & JD BECK, Sons of Kemet, Ezra Collective, Ibrahim Maalouf, Nina Simone, Melody Gardot, Diana Krall, Musica Nuda, Gregory Porter, José James...
